P_S69_1_column_sorted_and_zero_cost_bloc.statement: Sorting input columns by descending activation Hessian h_j before Block-H4 eliminates Track S68's +0.60..+0.92 dB outlier-spill penalty across 4-blocks AND co-locates equal-scale columns inside g=128 L2-ball groups. We test (a) global h_real sort (hA16_BlockH4_sort_real) vs unpermuted hA16_BlockH2_real and hA16_BlockH4_real across all 4 models, (b) intra-group-128 local sort (hA16_BlockH4_sort_grp128_real) to separate H_4 neighbor spill from cross-group ball co-location, (c) zero-text column sorting (A16_BlockH4_sort_wcol, A16_BlockH4_sort_hrand, hA16_BlockH4_sort_rand + matched-MSE control <= 2e-6 dB on 3B), and (d) zero-runtime-cost architectural offline folding on down_proj (verified exact BF16 identity) plus shared-RMSNorm permutation.

inequalities: coherent_cure_test: min(Coupled_Subblock_Oracle, Layer_Coherent_Oracle, ProjType_Uniform).wt_kl < PerMatrix_Oracle.wt_kl on Qwen2.5-3B
P_S69_2_cross_layer_non_additivity_disse.statement: Dissect Track S68's cross-layer non-additivity obstruction on Qwen2.5-3B (where held-out Oracle_1bit 0.050421 lost to uniform A16_axis 0.046686) vs SmolLM2-360M (where Oracle_1bit won by -6.7%) via (a) exact single-block additivity decomposition computing R_cross = KL_full / sum_l dKL_l across all L blocks for A16_axis, A16_BlockH4, PerMatrix_Oracle, and Layer_Coherent_Oracle, and (b) coupled-coherent routing ablations (Coupled_Subblock, Layer_Coherent, ProjType_Uniform, Coupled_RelRatio) across all 4 models.

P_S69_3_sm86_ptx_zerocost_and_shared_gat.statement: Compile standalone sm86_s69_sorted_blockh4_kernel.cu with nvcc -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=sm_86 --ptxas-options=-v and --ptx verifying 0 B stack/spill and 0 ld.local/st.local across all kernels, 0 syndrome errors, and 0 int64 bit-exact mismatches on real Qwen2.5-3B weights, benchmarking (i) down_proj-folded zero-cost sorted A16_BlockH4 (0% runtime overhead vs unpermuted BlockH4), (ii) shared-RMSNorm O(d) fused gather + A16_BlockH4 on Qwen2.5-3B gate/up and qkv shapes (< 3% end-to-end latency overhead), and (iii) naive inline per-GEMV gather control, with 100 Hz INA3221 GPU + intel-rapl CPU mJ/tok.
